title: Practical path to conversational Mandarin through self-study
why: Total study hours matter most; look up unknown words in example sentences, aim for about 10,000 passive words, and use transcripts for media.

title: Opinions on career moves for non-engineers in tech
why: Mostly personal opinion on location, job switching and loyalty, with little verifiable substance.

title: Argument that large sums make people act immorally
why: Moral argument and political opinion about taxes and human behavior, not explanatory substance.

title: How UK contractor agencies behave in downturns

title: Argument for laptops over slate tablets
why: Opinionated comparison of device form factors; the reasoning is mostly preference rather than a transferable explanation.

title: How banks create money through lending
why: When a bank lends, it creates a deposit elsewhere, so money supply grows beyond reserves while the central bank steers via the interest rate.

title: Learn a language by writing a program per feature
why: Write a small program for every language feature and run it under several compilers to expose real differences; sustained daily practice builds fluency.

title: Rant about Go's type system and generics

title: Dispute with moderators over a Google+ thread

title: Opinion on crypto and consumer banking

title: Gripes about code review tools after using them

title: Rebuttal of Stack Overflow claims by a rival site

why: Choose security approach by storage model (office, cloud, hybrid); hybrid setups inherit the weaknesses of both, and end users shouldn't own security decisions.

title: Personal account of depression in high school
why: Personal story about mental health with no technical or factual lesson for a general reader.

title: Commentary on a novel about political simulations

title: Quoted account of Canada's 1990s debt narrative

title: Personal question about what to do after college

title: Personal account of disability, suicidality and bureaucracy

title: Typing transducers in Haskell: indexing and early stopping
why: Types can enforce faithful accumulator threading and implement early termination by wrapping only the reduced value, countering claims that typing transducers is wasteful.

title: Opinion on young men's frustrations and online groups
why: Social commentary and advice based on personal observation, without a concrete lesson a technical reader would learn.

title: Sparse graphs versus adjacency matrices in APL
why: Adjacency matrices make neighbor lookup O(n) for sparse graphs; the APL Tarjan implementation shows matrix code is expressive but awkward for sparse data.

title: Rant about Lenovo buying experience and Apple
why: Frustrated complaints about product lineups and websites; opinion rather than explanation.

title: A model code comment explaining data structures

title: Anecdote about an absurd sysadmin interview
why: Entertaining interview anecdote with no transferable technical lesson beyond the author's frustration.

title: Distance from a point to a line segment
why: Project the point onto the segment direction with the dot product and clamp the parameter to [0,1] so endpoints give distance to the ends.

title: Hot dog analogy for copying digital content
why: Extended metaphor arguing about digital goods pricing; an argument by analogy rather than a factual explanation.

title: Argument against employees setting their own salaries
why: Opinion on management and cash planning, supported by a personal example rather than a general, checkable lesson.

title: Personal account of sleeping in a car across America
why: Personal travel anecdote with casual tips; not a structured guide and offers little transferable knowledge.

title: Nostalgic memories of BBS hacking in the 1980s

title: Satirical quote on contradictory definitions of electricity

title: How a blank field can cause a telecom outage

title: Personal struggle with fear of death

title: Argument for internationalism over nationalism

title: TN, IPS and VA panels compared for monitors
why: TN is fast but has poor color and viewing angles; IPS suits bright offices and VA suits dark rooms, and IPS variants need checking in specs.

title: Company announcement on synthetic fuel production
why: Promotional text from a company with unverified claims about its process and pricing; not an independent explanation.

title: Insider critique of German economic policy

title: Index junction table foreign keys for many-to-many joins

title: Calories versus macros for body recomposition
why: Calories drive weight change, but macronutrients decide whether loss is fat or muscle; eat enough protein and train for strength to lose fat intelligently.

title: Personal account of why twelve steps work

title: Commentary on a 1970s essay about sexuality
